svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries three metal lines. After it a thin flat layer of the same pale oxide covers the whole top.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step a flat pale oxide buries three metal lines. After it a thin flat layer of the same pale oxide covers the whole top.
svg.text: A thin plasma oxide is deposited on the polished surface.
After: a thin cap oxide on top
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
